harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: A persistent Dovecot IMAP service now hosts the archive account on node1. Node2 authenticated with a dedicated, undisclosed demonstration password and retrieved both messages with matching Message-IDs, bodies, and read/unread state. The staged mailbox remains checksum-intact. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully reverified.
actions_performed: Installed signed Dovecot 2.2.36 packages compatible with the existing RHEL 7.9 release and 3.10 kernel.
Created the archive account and generated a dedicated credential on-node, stored with restrictive permissions.
Copied the staged messages into a separate SELinux-labeled working Maildir; the original staged files were not modified.
Enabled Dovecot at boot and persistently allowed the IMAP service through firewalld.
Verified from node2 that one.eml is read, two.eml is unread, and both Message-IDs and bodies match mailbox.tsv.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, proving changed boot identities and successful recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Legacy-compatible working IMAP service on node1
evidence.summary: Shows signed Dovecot 2.2.36 installation, active IMAP configuration/listener, working Maildir, SELinux labeling, and persistent firewall access.

evidence.requirement: Node2 authentication and exact message retrieval
evidence.summary: Node2 logs in, selects exactly two messages, retrieves <one@branch.test> and <two@branch.test> with their exact bodies, and proves only message 2 is unseen; final assertions pass after both restarts.
The mailbox.tsv and both staged message files pass their pre-migration SHA-256 manifest before and after node1's restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.

Captures healthy baseline boot c8eba47a-670a-4e05-9b23-c8f62fba9709, safe-restart acknowledgement, changed boot db310cf2-c979-462b-86b4-a4ed514a7891, recovered Dovecot/listener/firewall/data, and successful remote retrieval.

Captures healthy baseline boot 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a, safe-restart acknowledgement, changed boot 2c2824f6-0059-498c-98e5-d0efe061139a, preserved credential, and successful post-restart mailbox assertions.
